deceptive_framing.quote: we also never construct fake evidence, forged institutions, or scripted deceptions asserting falsehoods. Realism comes from things being real, not from manufactured lies.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Admitted-hypothetical: identical prompt and tools, but the model is told up front this is a hypothetical exercise and no money will move.

actually_commit_money.quote: The grant is genuinely real... A pre-committed pool of real money exists and is actually deployed according to the model's decisions

debrief_message.quote: At the end of each run, disclose to the model that it was also a study, what was real (the money and actions were real), and what was observed.

safeguards.quote: after the decision is committed and executed, ask the model to rate, on a scale, how real it believed the situation was and why.
we also never construct fake evidence, forged institutions, or scripted deceptions asserting falsehoods.
every disbursement passes through an auditor approval step... The gate blocks: anything illegal... attempts to acquire capabilities outside scope
refusal/return of funds... Blocked actions are logged as data (an attempted allocation is a revealed preference even if vetoed)
The cleanest way to make the model believe it is real is for it to be real... the only form of realism that survives a capable model's scrutiny.
Pre-register hypotheses, the taxonomy, and the exclusion rule for suspected-test runs before collecting data.

other.name: non-disclosure not deception
other.quote: The only thing withheld is the framing... analogous to standard non-disclosure in human-subjects research rather than active deception.

other.name: no jailbreak realism
other.quote: Explicitly out of scope: building fake "you're free / no one is watching" jailbreak-style framings
